messages:
eva: Heads-up — ran into a weird JSON-mode shape flip when a tool fncall retried. LMK if this sounds familiar.

eva: Scenario: callTool(..., jsonMode: true) -> transport emits a single logical object split into two frames -> short-lived auth 401 causes retry -> assembler heuristics detect "multiple frames" and return TOP-LEVEL array of fragments instead of reconstructing original object -> downstream schema validator/consumer expects object -> crash.

mohit: Oh wow. Different from "array when single object" issues?

eva: Related class but subtly different: original payload is OBJECT that arrives as two frames (prefix and suffix). On retry we get the same two frames replayed, but assembler wraps them as [frag1, frag2] rather than merging into { ... }. So the app sees an array of partial fragments.

liam: Can you paste a minimal log?

eva: Log snippet:
```
transport frame A: "{\"user\": \"alice\", \"meta\": {"
transport frame B: "\"ok\": true}}"
retry -> replay frames A, B
assembly -> ["{\"user\": \"alice\", \"meta\": {", "\"ok\": true}}"]
validator -> expected OBJECT; got ARRAY of fragments -> parse error
```

mohit: Yikes. So the assembler is treating "multiple frames" as signals to build an array of completed frames, not to re-concatenate them. This will break any multi-frame objects.

liam: Two mitigation paths: 1) Always attempt to re-concatenate frames for jsonMode when frames are not themselves valid JSON tokens (detect partial starts/ends), 2) Add a replay-preserve header on the stream (e.g., __rw_shape=object|array) as meta so assembler knows intended top-level shape.

eva: For immediate unblock we should prefer approach 1 (re-concat if fragments look like partial tokens) plus a small fuzz test. Approach 2 is better long-term for union types and to avoid heuristics.

mohit: Agreed. I'll try a small hotfix to join adjacent frames when the pieces don't individually parse as JSON, and add a unit test reproducing a two-frame-object + retry. We'll also add parity test vs python.

support-bot: Created ticket DX-7129: "jsonMode: assembler returns array-of-fragments when object frames replayed -> validator crash". Linked support ticket 10817.

eva: Thanks — attaching a tiny repro harness to DX-7129. This blocked an onboarding demo so a quick patch would help. Also recommend we add a short note in onboarding docs pointing out jsonMode fragging caveat until patched.

liam: I'll add an assembly-debug flag behind debug=true to capture frame boundaries to make triage easier. Also adding a CI fuzz that randomizes chunk boundaries + auth retries to catch more variants.

mohit: Will open PR with fix + tests today.

eva: Cheers all :thumbsup:
